subject: physical-education
unitTitle: Grade 10 Capstone: Personal Activity Plan and LEVEL 1 Transition
title: Reteach and varied practice: self-assessment against the five standards under transfer
essentialQuestion: What have I built that is worth specializing in?
privacySafeScenario: Present a LEVEL 1 completion file and a justified LEVEL 2 specialization proposal to one trusted adult, and revise the proposal after critique.
studentTask: Learner works self-assessment against the five standards consolidated into the LEVEL 1 portfolio and defended, including the standard the learner is weakest in at a self-set intensity, then records what held, what degraded first, and how this occasion differed from the earlier one.
knowledgeCheck: In one concise response, say which feature of self-assessment against the five standards degraded first under the added demand, why, and what you would change before the next attempt.
completionCriteria: The learner holds self-assessment against the five standards consolidated into the LEVEL 1 portfolio and defended, including the standard the learner is weakest in, in whatever version their body and setting allow.
The learner names what degraded first and why, rather than reporting only whether it worked.
The learner compares this occasion with the earlier one and says what actually changed.
adaptationChoices: Presentation may be spoken one-to-one, written, or submitted as an annotated document. No recording, photograph, or audience beyond one adult is required.
extensionChallenge: Design the next progression of self-assessment against the five standards yourself, or coach the transfer condition to someone else so that they succeed with it — without completing another learner's graded work.
accessibilitySupports: Provide readable text plus optional audio or read-aloud support; no voice feature is required.
Chunk directions into one action at a time and show a worked example or model.
Allow typed, handwritten, spoken, drawn, demonstrated, or described responses when the standard permits.
Offer reduced-copying, extended-time, hidden-timer, rest-break, and low-distraction options.
Use captions, alt text, high-contrast print, keyboard access, and text-only fallbacks for media.
Preserve the learning target while adjusting quantity, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, or response mode.
Every movement task has a seated, supported, reduced-range, reduced-pace, and solo version that reaches the same standard.
Presentation may be spoken one-to-one, written, or submitted as an annotated document. No recording, photograph, or audience beyond one adult is required.

optionalReflection.prompt: Invite the learner to notice where self-assessment against the five standards shows up outside the session under real conditions. No purchase, account creation, photograph, recording, or public performance is required.

neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.
This task never requires calorie counting or a diet or weight-loss goal.
This task never requires disclosing private medical history, a diagnosis, or sexual history.
This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
This task never requires a public performance or an audience.
